hook.say: US states against whole countries, round two. Which is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: the US state of Georgia or Greece?
questions.say: Which is bigger: the U S state of Georgia, or Greece?
questions.fact: The US state of Georgia is about 17% bigger than Greece.
questions.sayAnswer: Georgia! The U S state is about seventeen percent bigger than Greece.

questions.q: Which is bigger: South Korea or Tennessee?
questions.fact: Tennessee is 9% bigger than South Korea, home to 51 million people.
questions.sayAnswer: Tennessee! It is nine percent bigger than South Korea, which is home to fifty-one million people.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Oregon or Romania?
questions.fact: Oregon is about 7% bigger than Romania.
questions.sayAnswer: Oregon! It is about seven percent bigger than Romania.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Minnesota or UK?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Minnesota or the U K?
questions.fact: The UK is about 9% bigger than Minnesota.
questions.sayAnswer: The U K! It is about nine percent bigger than Minnesota.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Italy or New Mexico?
questions.fact: New Mexico is about 4% bigger than Italy, with about 2 million people.
questions.sayAnswer: New Mexico! It is about four percent bigger than Italy, with only about two million people.
